 Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager \- Top of Funnel, this full\-time engineer will develop full\-stack features that improve how members discover and engage with care.  The Top of Funnel team owns the critical first steps of a member's journey, from registration and authentication to onboarding and provider matching. Your work will directly influence how millions of people access mental healthcare for the first time.

**What You'll Do...Position Summary**
 We are seeking a Distinguished Software Engineer to provide hands\-on, domain\-level technical leadership for Walmart’s Search Runtime platform. This role owns the technical vision and architecture, driving the design of scalable, AI\-powered search systems that serve billions of queries. You will shape long\-term strategy, lead critical architectural decisions, and influence multiple teams to deliver high\-impact solutions that improve product discovery and business outcomes. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, search technologies, and AI/ML\-driven relevance, along with a proven ability to operate across organizational boundaries to deliver impact at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Search team powers product discovery across Walmart’s global platforms, handling massive scale with strict latency and availability requirements. Whether a customer is searching for a specific item or browsing through categories, our platform powers the intelligence behind product discovery. We leverage large\-scale structured and unstructured data \- combined with advanced information retrieval, machine learning, and ranking algorithms \- to deliver highly relevant, personalized, and seamless discovery experiences.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Define and drive the technical strategy and architecture for Search Runtime across retrieval, ranking, indexing, and serving systems.
* Lead the design of scalable, low\-latency, high\-availability distributed systems.
* Build and evolve AI\-powered search capabilities including semantic search, vector retrieval, and ML\-driven ranking.
* Integrate ML/AI models into real\-time production systems to improve relevance and conversion.
* Drive operational excellence including observability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Lead large cross\-org initiatives and align engineering, product, and data science teams.
* Mentor and develop engineers across levels and raise the bar for design, code quality, and engineering practices.
* Identify and resolve system bottlenecks; drive continuous optimization and innovation.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree with 12\+ years (or Master’s with 10\+ years) in software engineering, building and scaling large distributed systems.
* Strong product and engineering mindset, linking system design decisions to customer experience and business outcomes.
* Deep expertise in search architectures, including retrieval, indexing, ranking, and system trade\-offs.
* Experience designing and operating run\-time orchestration systems for complex, distributed workflows and services.
* Strong experience with low\-latency, high\-availability services, performance optimization, and reliability at scale.
* Proficiency in backend technologies (Java/Spring or similar) and modern cloud\-native architectures.
* Proven ability to lead large, cross\-team engineering initiatives and influence system design across organizations.


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience in e\-commerce or marketplace platforms at scale.
* Experience working with global or multi\-region systems and teams.
* Experience building 0→1 products or launching new product surfaces.
* Background in fast\-scaling consumer technology companies.
